video_title: Michael Jordan's HILARIOUS Reason for Keeping Nelly as a Bobcats Owner

quotes.speaker: Nelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Nelly on his opportunity to join the Charlotte Bobcats ownership group
quotes.excerpt: Shout out to Bob Johnson because there was an opportunity to be a part of the first minority majority-owned NBA franchise.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: What made you want to get into that NBA ownership early like that?

text_blocks.speaker: Nelly
text_blocks.text: The fact that it is ownership, I don't think anybody is going to not take a look at that dream, especially in sports. Shout out to Bob Johnson because there was an opportunity to be a part of the first minority majority-owned NBA franchise with the owner of BET. So it was like, thank you for allowing me to go in.

quotes.speaker: Nelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Nelly on Michael Jordan's influence and his role as a Bobcats owner
quotes.excerpt: Mike came in and it was even doper because he was so cool to me.

text_blocks.speaker: Nelly
text_blocks.text: He allowed me to be a part of that man and it was dope. Then Mike came in and it was even doper because he was so cool to me. You don't know how that's going to go. That nigga might have wanted me out. He came in and bought out everybody else. I was like, why you ain't buy me out? I'm the low man on the totem pole. I'm the one that can really get to use it.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: He was like, nah, you funny. I'm keeping you.

text_blocks.speaker: Nelly
text_blocks.text: He was like, nah, you funny. I'm keeping you. And they think I'm bullshitting when I said that. He was like, nah, you funny. I'm going to keep you.

quotes.speaker: Nelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Nelly on the business dynamics of NBA ownership
quotes.excerpt: You see the dynamic in sports ownership and how that business works a little bit more.
quotes.quote: You see the dynamic in sports ownership and how that business works a little bit more because it is a business. You like people, you know these players, these are your people, and then them niggas might be gone tomorrow. You are like, damn, ain't nobody asked me if I wanted to trade.

quotes.speaker: Nelly

quotes.excerpt: I'm not playing this sports with this man. This man is the best to do it.
quotes.quote: We just spades, man. I'm not playing this sports with this man. This man is the best to do it. I was just a fucking waste of my time. I'm not playing basketball with Michael Jordan. He is cool, the same way in hooping, just don't wake his ass up. It was me and my little brother and him and Oakley. I think we were winning the first couple games and we got to talking shit.
